customer_answers:
For an ordinary Standard Visitor application, you do not need to buy flights or book a hotel just to supply booking evidence. The official guide describes hotel bookings and flight bookings (except transit) as less useful evidence. We can first record your intended arrangements without describing unbooked plans as confirmed bookings.

A decision usually takes up to 3 weeks after you have applied online, proved your identity and provided your documents—not from the day you start preparing. This is not a guaranteed deadline or a promise of approval. That is decision timing, not a passport-return date.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa
